novel_features.name: Fleet SSL audit
novel_features.description: Find every SSL certificate across every server that is missing, expiring soon, or already expired — one query, whole fleet.

novel_features.name: Reverse domain lookup
novel_features.description: Given a domain (or pattern), return the server, webapp, system user, and SSL config that hosts it.

novel_features.name: Fleet PHP version audit
novel_features.description: Find every webapp running below a given PHP version, grouped by server.

novel_features.name: Fleet health roll-up
novel_features.description: Show uptime, load, disk, and memory for every server in one comparable table, powered by v3's new /health/latest endpoint.

novel_features.name: Fleet blocked-IPs dedupe
novel_features.description: Show every fail2ban-blocked IP across the fleet, deduped, with server count, first seen, and last seen.

novel_features.name: Fleet WordPress/CMS inventory
novel_features.description: List every webapp that has a script-installer attached (WordPress, Joomla, Drupal, etc.) with version and site URL.

novel_features.name: Agency client onboarding chain
novel_features.description: Onboard a new agency client end-to-end: create client → assign server-package → spin up client-server → optional magic link. Emits a credentials summary.

novel_features.name: Fleet SSH-key audit
novel_features.description: Inventory every SSH key across every (server, system_user) pair, deduped by fingerprint.

novel_features.name: Fleet stale services
novel_features.description: Filter every server's services list for non-running rows or a named service across the whole fleet.
